name: 98036 · Lynnwood, WA
findings: ZIP 98036 (Lynnwood) has 138 nonprofit organizations. 69 of them (50%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 57 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (29% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 98036 (Lynnwood) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 98036 (Lynnwood) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.6 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 52 organizations here; 19% of all organizations here have no identified type.
